the monoclonal antibody alpha BFX-2b is a potent inhibitor of factor Xa activity in prothrombinse, but not of the prothrombin binding or activation site.

we have developed a monoclonal antibody that recognizes a unique epitope on the heavy chain that is not involved in prothrombin binding and cleavage but is required for prothombinase assembly and activity.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the antibody binds the active site of factor Xa, and that it does not prevent the assembly of the prothrombin complex.
we have identified a highly conserved, noncatalytic site on the factor Xa heavy chain that may be a target for the rational design of a new class of anticoagulants.
